label: L-01
title: CEI violation in _withdrawInternal: state updates occur after two external calls, creating a latent reentrancy exposure that relies entirely on nonReentrant being preserved on all callers
description: Interactions-before-Effects ordering in _withdrawInternal: (1) ammAdapter.swap() external call at line 364, (2) underlyingToken.safeTransfer() to recipient at line 367, then (3) clientBalances decrement at line 371, (4) totalDeposited decrement at line 372. The nonReentrant modifier on all current public callers prevents immediate exploitation. Latent risk escalates if a new call path is added without nonReentrant, or if vault/underlying token implements ERC777 hooks.
impact: Currently non-exploitable due to nonReentrant guards on all public entry points. Latent risk: double-withdrawal under any future refactoring or ERC777 token substitution.
attackPath: Currently blocked: all public callers (deposit, withdraw, withdrawAsOwner, totalWithdrawal, skimSurplus) carry nonReentrant
Latent path: new entry point added without nonReentrant + ERC777 vault/underlying token
Reentrancy during external call at line 364 (ammAdapter.swap) or line 367 (safeTransfer to recipient) before state decrements at lines 371-372 would allow double-withdrawal
